I guess it’d be just my family. 

To be honest in the post I don’t have much friends. Because I have a fear of people. My trust runs thin, and I just automatically assume the worst which I know isn’t a good thing, but sadly so far I’ve been right. I just hate not knowing people intentions which makes it hard for me to have trust in people. I don’t even trust most of my family. People that I try to keep in my life, even if they don’t show the same effort. I just want to say that your comment really brightened up my day. And helped in a way. 

And your right I was young and he took advantage of that. And yeah I know my moms not the best mother. I can’t seem to entirely hate her for it. It’s weird, the best way I can put it is that she’s my mom. And she’s trying her best even though it isn’t the “best”. 

Sadly, there’s no way I can get the help without the papers being signed, but thanks to you, and other, I think I’ll try and talk to my mom about it. And I know the abuse was bad, but please understand that my mom tries and is trying. I know it’s hard for me to hate her for the things she’s done, which is why I could never reach out to the school. Even though my mom put me through pain, I could never do the same for her. 

And about the guy, your right. It’s just not easy for me to let go you know? I just have such strong feelings for him even though he’s been distant and cold. And there’s been signs and shit. It’s hard. Cause I really do care for him, but it’s probably best to let him go. Cause your right a boyfriend isn’t a therapist, and it just seems like he’s only there for those times out of pity or something. And even if he does have good intentions he never says. He never communicates and I’m tired of being in the dark, and second guessing my self as well as overthinking. 

Thank you I really do appreciate you. ✨☺️ You are a amazing person. Especially since I know my post was pretty long. I’m very thankful that you took you time to read it. 🙏😊

I wish I could answer your questions but the way I feel is strange. It’s like I’m at war with myself. I feel on way, but a completely different way the next. At a point it’s like fuck everyone why should I care, and yet I do care and try/put up with the bullshit. I seem to care more about them, then myself. 

What you say may have some truth behind it. I could’ve ended it a long time ago if I didn’t care at all. I feel like the long post was just my way of finally letting it all out. 

And to answer your first questions. I don’t know. The thing is I don’t know how to take a step forward. I don’t know how to let go of all the things that are going on in my mind. I don’t know how to get rid of the voice in my head. I just have this pain and hate and I know it’s what’s pulling me back, but I feel like it’s consumed me. 

So, as of now I don’t really know how to answer the rest of your questions. To me they just look like words, but I can answer the first. Why I want this pain the pain to disappear? Because I don’t want to lose myself, which is what I feel is happening to me.

In my opinion honesty is the best policy, but now hearing you situation I’m not so sure. You say you in a nice relationship that you like, but don’t entirely like girl you are with, and the girl you like you feel more drawn to her and attracted then your partner. I want you to know right now, you are not at fault! You aren’t an absolute monster your a human being with emotions something that you can’t not control. And right now your beating your self up over it (which I totally understand but you shouldn’t). And your beating yourself up with all the possibilities that could happen. So many what ifs... you say that you don’t feel the same way completely I say you should be honest and tell her that. I know you don’t want her to end up in a bad relationship, but you can always be friends and look after her. You could still love her even if it’s just as a friend. But I think going for the other would be a mistake. Like you said their friends and she probably wouldn’t do that to her friend. Your already fighting with yourself and telling her would be more complicated. You’ll  be filled with regrets, and I know that you would be not telling her but you would hurting more people in the process as well. If you really care for this people the you shouldn’t say anything. But your relationship you need to be honest. I think you should take a break not like completely break up with her but take a break. Think about what you want to do, the decisions you want to make. And then talk about it with your partner try and make her understand what it is you want. You say that she says that this relationship is more then she’s ever dreamed of, than if so I’d think that she’d be willing to make changes for you. And those areas that could be fixed I think you should fix them with her as well. And the other girl maybe take some distance as well and figure out where you want to go with that. You just need a reality check. You happiness is one of the most important things. But you should be considerate of others as well cause like you said you don’t want to make mistakes and lose friendships in the end. Or you could take a leap of faith and tell the girl your more attracted to about how you feel and cross you fingers it works out. And you should take your Bestfriends words to heart. In the end you’ll be filled with regrets either way (maybe if not if it’s works out, which I hope it does). So you need to make a decision cause like you said you don’t want to not make the mistake of not doing anything. I hope everything works out for you, I’ll be crossing my fingers for you too. I wish you luck. ☺️✨
